name: output_saturation
description: setpoint=20 makes the proportional term alone (Kp*error = 2*20 = 40) far exceed limMax=10, so output clamps to 10 immediately -- before the integrator has had time to wind up to its own limit (limMaxInt=5). Run only 0.3s so the two clamps are caught at different points: output already saturated, integrator still ramping. That ordering is only visible by reading the two clamp statements in PID.c; the declared dependencies alone do not say which happens first.

metadata.derived_from: src/PID.c PIDController_Update, output clamp vs integrator clamp
metadata.author: Claude (Sonnet 5), reading the source directly

checks.description: Verified: output reaches exactly 10.0 immediately and integrator is still only ~3.05, well under its own 5.0 limit.
